name: PlexWatch
description: PlexWatch is a Discord bot that brings your Plex media server to life with a real-time dashboard. Monitor active streams, track SABnzbd downloads, and check server uptime—all directly in your Discord server.

variables.name: Discord - Authorized User IDs
variables.description: Comma-separated list of Discord user IDs authorized to admin the bot

variables.name: Discord - Channel ID
variables.description: Discord channel ID to send messages to

variables.name: Plex - Server URL
variables.description: URL of your Plex server (e.g., http://plex-server:32400)

variables.name: SABnzbd - URL
variables.description: Optional, SABnzbd URL (e.g., http://sabnzbd:8080) for integration

variables.name: SABnzbd - API Key
variables.description: Optional, SABnzbd API key for integration

variables.name: Uptime Kuma - URL
variables.description: Optional, Uptime Kuma URL (e.g., http://uptime-kuma:3001) for integration

variables.name: Uptime Kuma - Username
variables.description: Optional, Uptime Kuma username for authentication

variables.name: Uptime Kuma - Password
variables.description: Optional, Uptime Kuma password for authentication

variables.name: Uptime Kuma - Monitor ID
variables.description: Optional, Uptime Kuma monitor ID for integration

variables.name: Running In Docker
variables.description: Required for Docker running, do not change.
